# Savage Divide Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations

![Savage Divide Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations](/uploads/505_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Savage Divide treasure maps

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 01

The treasure is located west of the Federal Waste Disposal Area HZ-21 workshop. Starting from Dent & Sons Construction, walk towards the marker. In front of the half-fallen caution sign is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 02

Fast travel to the New Appalachia Central Depot. From the train station we head north along the tracks. The hill is between two tracks.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 03

From the Top of the World fast travel point, follow the cable car down. Walk up to the signpost. A little further down the slope lies a crashed cable car. In front of it is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 04

Go to Solomon's Pool. There is a wooden bridge there. Between the bridge and the rock is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 05

A large advertising sign can be seen above the Blackwater mine. Directly in front of the advertising sign is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 06

North of the Palace of the Twisted Path you can find the hill with the treasure in the cliff face.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 07

Starting from the "Mountains: Southern Lookout" in an easterly direction on a rocky outcrop is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 08

West of the Northern Cutthroat Camp, between the road and the train tracks, there is a rest stop with a rusted motorcycle. Between a beam on a beam and rock is the hill.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 09

Behind the Herbstacker hut there is a small forest. Run through the woods to a rocky slope. Look down. The hill is located among carrot flowers.

### Savage Divide Treasure Map 10

This hill is located east of the Bailey family cabin just before the Rift location, near a small lake. There are two rusty vehicles at the lake. The hill is on the hill in front of it.

## Savage Divide treasure map rewards

**Armor Blueprints:** Blueprint: Marine Diving Suit, Blueprint: Harness, Blueprint: Long Johns, Blueprint: Raider Leather, Blueprint: Leather Suit, Blueprint: Trapper Arms, Blueprint: Trapper Legs, Blueprint: Trapper Torso, Blueprint: Light Robot Armor, Blueprints: Robot Armor (Sturdy), Blueprints: Robot Armor (Heavy)
